name: Fisheries licence and logsheet compliance tool for vessels licensed in Tuvalu
text: - **Fisheries licence and logsheet compliance tool for vessels licensed in Tuvalu.** The Tuvalu Fisheries Authority's *Fisheries Management Regulations 2025* (published in 2026) set out permit and licensing procedures, vessel reporting obligations and mandatory Automatic Location Communicators (ALCs). This looked like a textbook regulatory trigger. It was killed by **SPC's TUFMAN2**, a cloud tuna data system for Pacific Island countries that takes data directly from SPC's e-reporting apps (**Tails, OnBoard, OnShore, OLLO**), by **iFIMS** (integrated observer and catch e-reporting), and by the **PNA / FFA vessel-registration and VMS systems**. These are free or donor-funded tools, mandated at regional level, with fleet-level buyers outside Tuvalu.

name: Customs declaration helper

name: Military registration and booking-exemption automation for employers
text:
- **Military registration and booking-exemption automation for employers.** This looked very strong: every employer is obliged, the rules change often (Resolution 916 of July 2025 changed the forms, and Resolution No. 812 brought new rules from 27 June 2026), there are monthly and 5- and 7-day notification deadlines, and penalties apply. It was killed because the state launched a **free Дія service on 13 Aug 2026**. In it, companies get data from the Оберіг register, update employee data and carry out reconciliation with ТЦК online. HR suites (BAS ЗУП-type modules, appendix-5 list templates) already cover the paperwork. The data is also highly sensitive, and the workflow could shrink sharply after demobilisation. Sources:

text: - **goAML for DNFBPs (DPMS and real estate).** The problem is real: 8,191 DPMS were registered on goAML by Jun 2025, 1.45M DPMSRs were filed in 2021–25, and AED 42m in fines were imposed in H1 2025. It is crowded, though: RapidAML (AML UAE), Citadel365, InfoAML (native goAML), DPMS Global, Zigram, KYCK and the amluae toolkits, and RAKEZ sells AML packages. Moved to "too competitive".

name: VSMS EFD / POS fiscal connector for Vanuatu SMEs
text: - **VSMS EFD / POS fiscal connector for Vanuatu SMEs.** This is a strong trigger, with a mandatory, per-sale workflow for about 3,000 businesses. **FiscoBridge** killed it: it already offers an accredited SDC, web invoicing, POS and API, and it reuses its Fiji FRCS VMS product. **AJC Bridge** covers Xero users. Accreditation is required before anyone can sell, and the buyer pool is too small to fight two incumbents.

text: - **VNPF schedule generator for employers.** A 2026 rate change took the rate from 8% to 12%. The free **VNPF Online Employer Portal**, payroll/EOR tools (Ontop, Carbonate) and accountants killed it. The task is monthly but simple, and the rate change is a one-off.

  - https://vietnamfinance.vn/doanh-thu-ban-san-pham-bao-bi-duoi-30-ty-nam-duoc-loai-tru-trach-nhiem-epr-d124196.html
  - https://vietnamnews.vn/economy/1694613/enterprises-strengthen-environmental-responsibility-through-epr-implementation.html
  - https://kpmg.com/vn/vi/home/phan-tich-chuyen-sau/2025/02/key-amendments-to-vietnam-environment-protection-regulations.html

name: CBAM for steel and fastener exporters
text: - **CBAM for steel and fastener exporters:** many CBAM SaaS tools and certification bodies; enterprise buyers.

name: EUDR for coffee, rubber and wood
text: - **EUDR for coffee, rubber and wood:** crowded EUDR platforms plus government and large-exporter in-house systems.

name: Clinic EMR (Circular 13/2025/TT-BYT) and BHYT XML export
text: - **Clinic EMR (Circular 13/2025/TT-BYT) and BHYT XML export:** many HIS and clinic vendors.

name: Pharmacy drug-database and e-prescription connection
text: - **Pharmacy drug-database and e-prescription connection:** pharmacy POS vendors already integrate.

name: Import clearance document pack (UNVIM + customs)
text: - **Import clearance document pack (UNVIM + customs):** killed by OFAC/FTO exposure for Hodeidah importers and by UN/ASYCUDA systems that third parties cannot access. Freight forwarders and clearing agents in Djibouti and Dubai already do this work manually as a service.

name: Exchange-house transfer reporting
text: - **Exchange-house transfer reporting:** killed by CBY-Aden's mandated UNMONEY network, which is regulator-provided infrastructure, plus bank-grade core-banking vendors.

name: - None identified. The market never got as far as competitive analysis
text: - None identified. The market never got as far as competitive analysis.

name: Smart Invoice issuing integration (ERP/POS to VSDC)
text: - **Smart Invoice issuing integration (ERP/POS to VSDC).** Killed by a crowded integrator field: Greytrix (Sage), Serpa (Odoo), Upbuff (SAP B1), Satva, Flick Network, Pay-e Zambia, Zamsmart, Edicom and ClearTax. Fiscal devices cover the smallest shops.

name: Payroll statutory returns (PAYE/SDL, NAPSA, NHIMA, 2026 PAYE bands)
text: - **Payroll statutory returns (PAYE/SDL, NAPSA, NHIMA, 2026 PAYE bands).** Killed by the Odoo `l10n_zm_payroll` module (v18 and v19), Sage payroll and local platforms (Satva built one for a Zambian client). This is an annual band update, not a new workflow.

name: ZPPA / government-vendor document packs as a standalone product
text: - **ZPPA / government-vendor document packs as a standalone product.** This is generic document collection. ZPPA e-GP registration is free. The useful part is folded into opportunity 2.

name: - ZRA Smart Invoice issuing (see above)
text: - ZRA Smart Invoice issuing (see above).

name: - Payroll statutory computation and returns (see above)
text: - Payroll statutory computation and returns (see above).

name: ZIMRA fiscalisation reconciliation (FDMS)
text:
- **ZIMRA fiscalisation reconciliation (FDMS).** Fiscalisation is mandatory, but there are many
  ZIMRA-accredited fiscal-device, POS and ERP vendors, and accounting packages already cover it.
  I could not verify an exception-handling gap. The rejection is **provisional**: I could not
  check the vendor landscape (search refused).

name: - ZIMRA fiscal devices and POS (see above; provisional)
text: - ZIMRA fiscal devices and POS (see above; provisional).

name: Street vendors and markets
text: - **Street vendors and markets.** The state already issues digital vendor cards via the Citizen Portal (DP 111/24), and the vendors have no money.

name: Taxi/minibus licensing helper
text: - **Taxi/minibus licensing helper.** The Vehicle and Road Traffic (Amendment) Act 2025 raised licence fees and confused operators (Antigua Observer, https://antiguaobserver.com/?p=308653 and https://antiguaobserver.com/?p=309199). But renewal is annual, it is handled through associations (UTC and others) and at the Transport Board counter, and the pain is about cost, not paperwork. The sector is getting two seats on the Transport Board (https://antiguaobserver.com/?p=320626), so the problem is being solved politically, not with software.

name: Heritage Quay vendor registration
text: - **Heritage Quay vendor registration.** About 150 vendors register with SJDC (https://sjdcanu.com/vendors_mall); a one-off registration with no recurring filing.

name: Household employers of domestic workers
Pest control and tank cleaning certificates (CABA)
text: - **Pest control and tank cleaning certificates (CABA):** APRA's EDA system already sells and generates certificates online with QR stickers (since 2015). Other municipalities are fragmented but small, and no 2025–2026 trigger was found.

name: Street-taxi compliance
text: - **Street-taxi compliance** (licence, receipt per ride, 5% cash duty in 2026). Platforms handle receipts for most rides, and the remaining drivers are individuals who use eHDM apps. Source: https://www.arka.am/en/news/business/new_taxi_regulations_in_armenia_to_take_effect_on_september_1

name: Pawnshops and exchange offices
text: - **Pawnshops and exchange offices.** Licensed by the CBA and recurring, but few independent operators, mature CBA reporting, and likely covered by local accounting vendors (unverified). I'd revisit them only with access to the CBA's reporting form list. Sources: https://arlis.am/en/acts/182322, regalert.today CBA resolutions

name: Pawnbrokers / second-hand dealers
text: - **Pawnbrokers / second-hand dealers:** NSW Police Weblink with a published dealer software specification and approved record-keeping software. A mature ecosystem.

name: Household employers
text: - **Household employers:** Pay The Nanny, NannyPay, Domestic Payroll and CarePayCo. Payday Super and the SBSCH closure were absorbed by these services and payroll apps.

name: Mobile food vendors
text: - **Mobile food vendors:** the NSW mutual-recognition reform (2025) and Vic Streatrader shrink the fragmentation.

name: Household employers (DLS)
text: - **Household employers (DLS):** free DLS-Online. Households don't buy software.

name: Tattoo studios, taxis
text: - **Tattoo studios, taxis:** not offline, or already served by apps.

name: Livestock identification and the move to an electronic animal exchange
text:
- **Livestock identification and the move to an electronic animal exchange:**
  - The trigger is strong: 28 animal markets were closed in Oct 2025 over foot-and-mouth disease and veterinary-sanitary failures, and markets will move to an exchange where buyers see identification data online.
  - But AQTA vets tag the animals and enter the data into AQTİS themselves, and the state will build the exchange.
  - So there is no private buyer for software. At most there might one day be a tender.
  - Sources: [azinforum](https://azinforum.az/iqtisadiyyat/azerbaycanda-enenevi-heyvan-bazarlari-baglanir-mal-qara-birjalarda-satilacaq), [banker.az](https://banker.az/t%C9%99s%C9%99rrufatlarda-heyvanlarin-identifikasiyasi-baslanib/), [bayraqdar.info](https://www.bayraqdar.info/2026/09/22/heyvanlarin-identifikasiyasi-v%C9%99-ucotu-uzr%C9%99-t%C9%99dbirl%C9%99r-davam-edir/).

name: Taxi operators
text: - **Taxi operators:** a one-off permit renewed every 7 years. AYNA and Bolt already cover the flow.

name: Bazaar traders
text: - **Bazaar traders:** e-kassa vendors and the State Tax Service own this.

name: Jitney and taxi franchise compliance
text: - **Jitney and taxi franchise compliance.** There is a single receiving body (the Road Traffic Department Franchise Unit, which works by counter and phone), and renewal is annual. The owner-drivers have no software budget. Sources: https://www.roadtraffic.gov.bs/?p=5085, https://roadtraffic.gov.bs/?p=3391

name: Straw Market vendor fees
text: - **Straw Market vendor fees.** The obligation is fee payment to one Authority, and enforcement is by lockout. Only the Authority itself could buy a system, through government procurement. Sources: https://www.tribune242.com/comments/cr/124/15455/, https://www.tribune242.com/comments/cr/124/68195/, https://ewnews.com/?p=97622

name: Enhanced WPS for SMEs
text:
- **Enhanced WPS for SMEs.** Not a quiet industry. It covers all private employers, and banks and
  payroll vendors file it.

name: Tobacco digital stamps
text: - **Tobacco digital stamps.** NBR's own app covers the retailer side.

name: Overseas recruiting agencies
text: - **Overseas recruiting agencies.** They looked like a fit for the "one job, many receiving authorities" pattern (BMET clearance plus destination-country visa portals). They are rejected because BMET's A-RMS, RAIMS and OEP are free and already used by about 85% of agencies, and commercial recruitment software such as Palazon exists.

name: Street vendors under the National Vending Act
text: - **Street vendors under the National Vending Act:** the dispute is about licence renewal and location; there's no money in it. Source: https://barbadostoday.bb/2025/12/17/whither-the-vendors-act-four-years-on/

name: Heating-attest apps (three regions)
text: - **Heating-attest apps (three regions).** Testo Pro+ and EuroSoft Attest already issue Flemish, Brussels and Walloon certificates on site.

name: PAB/PVB budget-holder payroll
text: - **PAB/PVB budget-holder payroll.** Social secretariats, Helpper, Partner in Assistentie and budget-holder associations already do it.

name: Flemish taxi operators
text: - **Flemish taxi operators.** Licensing is one-off, and trips already run through apps.

name: Domestic-worker CNSS declarations
text: - **Domestic-worker CNSS declarations.** The obligation is real and enforced (2023 ultimatum, criminal penalties), but CNSS, DGI and ASIN built the free "Gens de maison" platform, linked to ANIP, in Nov 2023. The substitute is the state platform plus the household's own accountant. The leftover (payslips) is a generic payroll app.

name: Private-school EducMaster double entry
text: - **Private-school EducMaster double entry.** The state platform is free and mandatory, with no known API. School management software is a crowded generic category. Revisit only if EducMaster opens a CSV import that third-party tools could feed.

name: Moto-taxi licensing and professional cards
text: - **Moto-taxi licensing and professional cards.** A municipal B2G system, and drivers pay XOF 4,800 a year. Nothing for an indie vendor.

name: Livestock / transhumance
text: - **Livestock / transhumance.** State vets issue the certificates. Cross-border transhumance is restricted. Herders don't buy software.

name: Meat shops / abattoirs
text: - **Meat shops / abattoirs:** the Livestock Bill 2025 was still in re-deliberation in Jun 2026. Slaughter is religiously sensitive, the shop count is small, and the BAFRA permits are issued by inspectors. Sources: https://thebhutanese.bt/national-assembly-accepts-ncs-changes-in-livestock-bill-of-bhutan-2025/, https://asianews.network/?p=279462, https://thebhutanese.bt/despite-bafra-assurances-meat-vendors-and-restaurants-sell-and-serve-rotting-meat/

name: Micro traders / street vendors
text: - **Micro traders / street vendors:** micro trade is de-licensed and the street-vending rules are not yet written. Sources: https://leap.unep.org/en/countries/bt/national-legislation/bhutan-micro-trade-regulation-2006, https://thebhutanese.bt/moice-minister-says-street-vendors-will-be-allowed-but-with-rules-and-specified-locations/

name: Taxi
text: - **Taxi:** the licence is one-off; fiscalization is covered by POS vendors (see the country report).

name: Livestock trader, agent and feedlot permits during the 2026 FMD crisis
text: - **Livestock trader, agent and feedlot permits during the 2026 FMD crisis.** The trigger is real: suspected FMD from 28 Jan 2026, all movement permits revoked, the EU withdrew fresh-beef authorisation on 21 Apr 2026, and internal movement eased on 5 May 2026. But permits and BAITS (registration, transfers, treatments, deaths) are free government systems, run through DVS offices and **BAITS cafés/agents**. The cafés are the substitute and already the offline channel. Buyer licences fall under Cap 36:01, and the number of licensees is unknown. This is a government or donor project, not indie SaaS.

name: RENAVE for used-car lots
text:
- **RENAVE for used-car lots.**
  - The strongest trigger found: mandatory nationwide from 28 Sep 2026.
  - Killed by at least 6 homologated integrators and dealer-software vendors already selling it: BNDV, Revenda Mais, Autoconf, RenaveFácil, RenaveAuto, Trillia B3.
  - Becoming an integrator also requires homologation by Senatran, the federal traffic secretariat.
  - Sources: https://www.portaldotransito.com.br/noticias/renave-torna-se-obrigatorio-nacionalmente-saiba-o-que-muda-para-lojistas-e-consumidores/amp/ ; https://bndv.com.br/renave ; https://www.renaveauto.com.br/

name: Auto-dismantler parts tagging
text: - **Auto-dismantler parts tagging.** The DETRANs credential the tag-and-software suppliers (e.g., Valid in Goiás), and the regime has been mature since 2018. Sources: https://www.jornalopcao.com.br/ultimas-noticias/lei-do-desmanche-lojas-de-pecas-e-desmontes-precisam-se-cadastrar-ate-o-dia-31-de-julho-130290/ ; https://www.legisweb.com.br/legislacao/?id=482844

name: FNRH Digital for pousadas
text: - **FNRH Digital for pousadas.** The free government module is designed for lodgings without a PMS, and PMS vendors integrate through the API. Sources: https://brasilturis.com.br/2026/03/26/hoteis-e-pousadas-devem-adotar-ficha-digital-de-hospedes-ate-20-de-abril/ ; https://myfrontdesk.cloudbeds.com/hc/en-us/articles/42670351711899-Brazil-New-Guest-Reporting-Requirement-FNRH

name: Dumpster-rental e-CTR router
text:
- **Dumpster-rental e-CTR router.**
  - The fragmentation pattern fits the Florida grease benchmark, but there are at least 7 vertical tools, the cheapest from R$199.90 per month.
  - Before reviving the idea, check whether these tools file to each city's e-CTR portal.
  - Sources: https://www.residuosonline.com.br/ ; https://enkad.com.br/software-para-locacao-de-cacambas/ ; https://www.saopaulo.sp.leg.br/blog/secretario-adia-fiscalizacao-eletronica-sobre-destinacao-de-cacambas/

name: Independent driving instructors
text: - **Independent driving instructors.** Government app plus generic scheduling.

name: Jewellers' AML (DPMS)
text: - **Jewellers' AML (DPMS):** Too few shops. Regional AML vendors (e.g. Arctic Intelligence) already cover Brunei. Source: https://arctic-intelligence.com/countries/compliance-brunei

name: Household employers of domestic workers (direct)
text: - **Household employers of domestic workers (direct):** Households act through agencies. They are consumers, not software buyers.

name: Livestock movement certificates
text: - **Livestock movement certificates:** issued by the communal vet; the trader pays per certificate and has no reason to buy software. The state is the only buyer.

name: Private security companies
text: - **Private security companies:** only about 25 approved firms. Prefects' inspections are campaign-based, and the payroll/CNPS side is already served by Odoo and Sage (see the main report).

name: Fishing ELOGs
text: - **Fishing ELOGs:** mandatory expansion in 2026, but DFO-qualified app market exists (VeriCatch and others) and harvesters resist even CAD 60/season. Sources: https://www.dfo-mpo.gc.ca/elogs, https://ffaw.ca/notice-to-fish-harvesters-electronic-logbook-elog-implementation-2026-fishing-season-nf-26-006/, https://vericatch.com/dfo-elogs-choose-your-preferred-provider/

name: Ontario neonic seed vendors
text: - **Ontario neonic seed vendors:** sales reporting removed in 2020. Source: https://cela.ca/guest-blog-phase-in-of-ontarios-neonic-regulation-hits-new-milestone/

name: Pharmacy and depot compliance
text: - **Pharmacy and depot compliance:** Bangui officines are capped at about 20. The December 2025 crackdown hit informal "mini pharma" sellers, who are not software buyers. Sources: https://acap-rca.com/2025/12/04/le-collectif-des-vendeurs-des-produits-pharmaceutiques-denonce-la-fermeture-de-leurs-officines/, https://www.sangonet.com/afriqg/PAFF/Dic/santC/medicam-gachis-rca.html

name: Rural sanitary services (SSR) management
text: - **Rural sanitary services (SSR) management:** APR Software already serves more than 300 of about 2,600 SSR, and the buyers are cash-poor volunteer committees.

name: Agricultural-intermediary registration
text: - **Agricultural-intermediary registration:** a one-off DT registration. The recurring payroll work is served by payroll SaaS.

name: Hotel and homestay guest registration
text: - **Hotel and homestay guest registration:** the police app or system is mandatory. There's no room for a third-party workflow layer.

name: Reverse invoicing for recyclers (反向开票)
text:
- **Reverse invoicing for recyclers (反向开票):** the strongest money-backed workflow found (13,300 enterprises, a 2024 trigger), but 开灵科技 and e-invoicing incumbents already sell scale-to-invoice systems, and they need tax-platform access.
---

name: Domestic-worker employers (Ley 2466/2025)
text: - **Domestic-worker employers (Ley 2466/2025).** New duties (written contract, PILA for by-the-day workers). Symplifica and Nómina en Línea (Aportes en Línea) already cover contracts, social-security enrolment, payroll and settlement. It's a B2C trap.

name: Domestic-worker payroll for households
text:
- **Domestic-worker payroll for households.**
  - About 170,575 workers, only about 14% properly insured. Employers must register with CCSS within 8 days and buy INS RT-Hogar.
  - CCSS's Oficina Virtual has a dedicated domestic module with automatic bank debit, and part-time contribution bases exist.
  - mabbi.app already targets domestic employers.
  - The remaining problem is informality, which depends on households choosing to comply. That is not a workflow gap.
  - Sources: https://www.ccss.sa.cr/web/trabajadora-domestica/ ; https://elmundo.cr/costa-rica/aseguramiento-de-trabajadoras-domesticas-sobrepasa-expectativas-de-la-ccss/ ; https://mabbi.app/incapacidad-empleada-domestica-ccss-ins/

name: Herd-management app for ranchers
text: - **Herd-management app for ranchers.** Identigan and GanApp already sell to ranchers using the areteo as their hook, and Trazar-Agro's own app is free.

name: Small-scale fishermen catch logging (2026 rules)
text: - **Small-scale fishermen catch logging (2026 rules):** The state provides free mOčevidnik, eOčevidnik and mRecFish apps ([morski.hr](https://www.morski.hr/od-1-sijecnja-novi-pravilnik-o-dostavi-podataka-o-ulovu-u-gospodarskom-ribolovu/), [Glas Istre, May 2026](https://www.glasistre.hr/more-i-nautika/2026/05/24/idete-u-ribolov-novi-pravilnik-donosi-obvezu-koja-se-mnogima-nece-svidjeti-1071039)).

name: Taxi and street-vendor licence/tax helper
text: - **Taxi and street-vendor licence/tax helper:** the burden is real, but there is no payment rail and the free substitute is WhatsApp or Telegram groups plus a contador.

name: All mipyme-facing ideas
text:
- **All mipyme-facing ideas:** see the country report (MINCOM-certified software, sanctions, payment rails).
---

name: Scrap metal dealer register software
text: - **Scrap metal dealer register software:** enforcement exists (https://cyprus-mail.com/2026/07/23/over-a-tonne-of-electricity-cables-seized-by-police-overnight), but no purchase-register or reporting duty was found, only 20 premises were inspected, and the trade is small and cash-based. No evidence of recurring regulator filings.

name: Domestic-worker payroll/payslip app
text: - **Domestic-worker payroll/payslip app:** Social Insurance and the Migration Department are the receiving bodies, but households are consumers who will not pay SaaS prices.

name: Grower fruit distilleries
text: - **Grower fruit distilleries.** 541 operators keep per-batch records and file a monthly excise return. Already served by SYScore "SW evidence pěstitelské pálenice" (XML export for Customs), Hradecký Pacov's program and the free Customs EPP template. No 2026 change. Sources: https://www.syscore.cz/index.php/prodej/prodej-sw-evidence-pestitelske-palenice , https://celnisprava.gov.cz/cz/dane/WebSPD/WebLih/Stranky/VzoryPP.aspx , https://www.e15.cz/byznys/potraviny/pocet-registrovanych-palenic-dal-stoupa-834027

name: Hunting associations
text: - **Hunting associations.** 5,778 hunting grounds and new NV 24/2026 wild-boar subsidy rules from 1 Sep 2026, but the market is crowded: iHonitba (auto-generates MYSL forms), eMyslivost, Hunterra, the free "Evidence myslivosti", and a comparison site. Sources: https://ihonitba.cz/ , https://www.myslivecke-aplikace.cz/ , https://www.cmmj.cz/myslivecke-prispevky-maji-od-zari-nova-pravidla/ , https://csu.gov.cz/vykazy/mysl-mze-1-01-rocni-vykaz-o-honitbach-stavu-a-lovu-zvere-od-1-dubna-2025-do-31-brezna-2026_psz_2025

name: Small waterworks software
text:
- **Small waterworks software:** close to rejected, because Danske Vandværker's Tethys and its paper
  system already serve the segment (kept above only as a service angle).

name: Khat import tax and licence compliance
text: - **Khat import tax and licence compliance.** Killed by concentration. Imports run through a few licensed importers, historically the SOGIK monopoly. Per-kg taxes are collected at entry by the state. Retail vendors have no filing obligation. Sources: https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/732701468247481705/pdf/628230FRENCH0P0KHAT0Banque0mondiale.pdf , https://www.icij.org/investigations/collateraldamage/qats-soothing-effects-mask-its-true-roles-revenue-and-control/ , https://prame.openum.ca/2025/10/15/khat-et-geopolitique-a-djibouti/

name: Household employer CNSS / payslips for domestic workers
text: - **Household employer CNSS / payslips for domestic workers.** Killed by informality. ILO says the 2006 Labour Code and CNSS cover only regular migrants, many Ethiopian migrants work informally, and ILO recommends regularisation. I found no Djibouti-specific household declaration scheme of the kind Morocco and Benin run. The general payroll case is already covered (and scored 3/10) in the country report. Sources: https://www.ilo.org/media/89446/download , https://www.ilo.org/sites/default/files/wcmsp5/groups/public/@africa/@ro-abidjan/@sro-addis_ababa/documents/publication/wcms_867976.pdf

name: Money changers / remittance operators
text: - **Money changers / remittance operators.** Killed by the small buyer count. There are 18 operators, all on the BCD's public list, and AML tooling is crowded. Sources: https://banque-centrale.dj/les-etablissements-agrees/ , https://migrantmoney.uncdf.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Djibouti-Diagnostic-Report-FR.pdf

name: Market vendors, beekeepers, second-hand dealers
text: - **Market vendors, beekeepers, second-hand dealers:** populations too small and informal; not checked further.

name: Pharmacy controlled-drug reporting
text: - **Pharmacy controlled-drug reporting:** the regulator's own portal, DNCD Digital (launched 2022), already covers all 1,259 Class B pharmacies ([El Día](https://eldia.com.do/dncd-cambia-forma-de-adquirir-medicamentos/), [Minpre annual report](https://memorias.minpre.gob.do/api/documents/3282/download)).

name: Used-car lots, transfer paperwork
text: - **Used-car lots, transfer paperwork:** the bottleneck was ANT being closed (Jan–Mar 2026), not a workflow software can fix. Their UAFE duty is covered by opportunity 2. ([Primicias](https://www.primicias.ec/sociedad/suspension-temporal-compra-venta-carros-nuevos-usados-ant-115093/))

name: Bus and microbus subsidy compliance
text: - **Bus and microbus subsidy compliance.** The compensation requires GPS with real-time transmission to the VMT; hardware vendors do this. Operators are squeezed and paid up to 6 months late. 9,092 permits. (https://www.elsalvador.com/dinero-y-negocios/transporte-autobuses-viceministerio-de-el-salvador/1277676/2026/ ; https://asamblea.gob.sv/node/11861)

name: Malabo market traders
text: - **Malabo market traders:** the burden is in-person tax collection by municipal inspectors, which press reports describe as often diverted ([Diario Rombe](https://diariorombe.es/magazine/el-mercado-central-de-malabo-lugar-paradogicamente-emblematico-de-la-ciudad/), [Diario Rombe on reform](https://diariorombe.es/ultimas-noticias/la-alcaldesa-malabo-obliga-los-comerciantes-reformar-mercado-central-malabo-propios-recursos/)). That is a governance problem, not a software one.

name: Money changers
text: - **Money changers:** informal, and foreign exchange is already covered by the BEAC import file in the country report.

name: Import-licence paperwork service
text: - **Import-licence paperwork service.** The pain is real (reports of more red tape on import licences). The substitute is personal relationships at MOTI and with the state forex allocation, and no software can address that.

name: Coastal fishing logbooks
text: - **Coastal fishing logbooks.** Substitute: the free PERK app (perk.agri.ee), which files to two agencies at once. Sources: https://www.agri.ee/uudised/kalurid-saavad-hakata-puugiandmeid-esitama-mobiilirakenduses, https://pta.agri.ee/ettevotjale-tootjale-ja-turustajale/kutseline-kalapuuk

name: Livestock market traders and export suppliers
text:
- **Livestock market traders and export suppliers.** The government ETLITS (MoA, built with
  USAID, EU, AU and World Bank support) is the traceability system. Proclamation 819/2014
  licensing is a one-off. A draft directive would remove brokers altogether. Traders pay in cash
  and have no software budget.
  ([Reporter](https://www.thereporterethiopia.com/39833/),
  [ETLITS](https://etlits.moa.gov.et/who-we-are),
  [LEAP/FAOLEX](https://leap.unep.org/en/countries/et/national-legislation/live-animals-marketing-proclamation-no-8192014))

name: Cattle movement permits
text: - **Cattle movement permits:** BAF authorises each movement itself under its SOPs. The users are smallholders, and there is nothing for third-party software to plug into.

name: Household employer FNPF
text: - **Household employer FNPF:** households won't pay, coverage is voluntary, and payroll tools exist. The FNPF cut to 8% from 1 Aug 2026 is a payroll-vendor update, not an opening.

name: Inland fishermen's catch report
text: - **Inland fishermen's catch report:** filed once a year, with an official web system and app. Source: https://ssak.fi/saalisilmoitus/

name: Seasonal farm-worker housing and permits
text:
- **Seasonal farm-worker housing and permits:**
  - About 2,300 seasonal work certificates a year and a few hundred farm employers.
  - The obligations (Migri accommodation guidance, written tenancy, OSH inspections) are per season, and the permit side runs through Migri.
  - Too few buyers for software. At most an employer-union service.
  - Sources: https://migri.fi/en/accommodation-for-seasonal-workers, https://tyosuojelu.fi/-/tyosuojeluviranomaisen-viesti-maatalouden-tyonantajille, https://migri.fi/documents/5202425/7004840/TY6_plus_Liitelomake+kausity%C3%B6t%C3%A4+koskevaan+hakemukseen_fi.pdf/aa21d03b-e62e-0d05-8941-2700295986bd?t=1770215855848, https://emn.fi/wp-content/uploads/EMN_EN_Maahanmuuton_tunnusluvut_2025_EN.pdf

name: Scrap and second-hand dealers
text: - **Scrap and second-hand dealers:** no police dealer register was found. The waste side belongs to the SIIRTO vendors.

name: Collective-pool surveillance, 2027 transfer from the ARS to operators
text: - **Collective-pool surveillance, 2027 transfer from the ARS to operators:** This was the best trigger found (décret 2026-118 and arrêté of 23 June 2026, in force 1 Jan 2027, covering campsites, hotels and residences). It is killed by competition: Becarepool, Poolog (Neptech), Aquatycia, E-Carnet, Naly and Piscilog already sell digital carnets sanitaires. The accredited labs that will run the new sampling programmes are the natural integrators. Results are kept available to the ARS, not transmitted, so there is no filing router to build. Sources: https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/jorf/id/JORFTEXT000054321840 , https://www.aquaproxima.fr/piscines-fin-prelevements-ars-controle-exploitant/ , https://becarepool.com/ , https://poolog.fr/ , https://www.aquatycia.fr/carnet-sanitaire-piscine

text: - **Forex bureaux compliance**: few operators, CBG-supervised, AML software is regional/global.

name: Small sewage plant maintenance protocols
text: - **Small sewage plant maintenance protocols:** a textbook "one job, several receiving bodies" case (municipality, lower water authority, sewage association). But U.A.N.'s DiWa5 already defines a nationwide interface, and LinWAS, DiWapp/homebook and Click+Clean (Börsch) build on it. https://www.uan.de/dienstleistungen/diwa-digitales-wartungsprotokoll ; https://www.linstep.de/instandhaltung-wartung-software/linwas-wartungssoftware-kleinklaeranlagen/

text: - **Gun-dealer NWR reporting:** electronic by law since 2020; certified vendors. https://www.mtrlegal.com/wiki/nationales-waffenregister-nwr/
